commentary.text: 90+5' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Although Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is just on the bench, Guillermo Cuadra has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+3' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
90+1' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle as Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
89' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
87' 2 - 3 Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
86' 1 - 3 Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
86' Here is a change. Inaki Williams is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
86' Substitution. Oihan Sancet will be replaced by Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
84' The corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is intercepted by Unai Simon.

84' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
81' The flag is raised and Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside again, not for the first time today.
80' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 15:16.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Jorge Pascual (Villarreal) is replacing Ilias Akhomach.
76' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replaces Nico Williams.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) will replace Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
76' Kiko (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
74' It must be a yellow card. It is. Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
72' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Raul Albiol (Villarreal) for a tough tackle.

72' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Unai Simon anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
71' What a chance! Alex Baena (Villarreal) blasts a first-time shot from inside the box that rattles the left post.
70' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
69' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) cracks a first-time shot from inside the box, but it flies way wide of the left post.
68' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
67' A substitution has been made. Gorka Guruzeta goes off and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
67' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
66' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
65' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared to safety by the defence.
65' Pacheta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kiko (Villarreal) replacing Adria Altimira.
64' Dani Parejo goes off the pitch and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) comes on.

64' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
64' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
63' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
62' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
61' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
61' Alex Baena (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
59' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
59' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
58' The ball is cleared after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' PENALTY APPEAL after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
56' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
52' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.

52' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Unai Simon anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
51' Flag up against Alex Baena (Villarreal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
50' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
50' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
49' The attendance is 18709.
48' Flag goes up against Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) will not participate anymore and Aissa Mandi is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Pacheta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Carlos Romero (Villarreal). He is replaced by Alberto Moreno.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The resulting corner, taken by Alex Baena (Villarreal), comes to nothing.

45+3' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
45+3' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45' A pass from Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
44' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Filip Jorgensen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
40' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Raul Albiol (Villarreal) and blew his whistle.
38' A short pass finds Alex Baena (Villarreal). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
36' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

34' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Unai Simon easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.

30' 0 - 3 Brilliant finish! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Oihan Sancet, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:3.
28' Adria Altimira (Villarreal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
27' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
26' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' 0 - 2 Goal! Oihan Sancet feeds Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
21' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alex Baena (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
21' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Alex Baena (Villarreal).
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.

13' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
12' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
12' Villarreal keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
9' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal). Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Villarreal are going to take it.
5' A pass from Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Filip Jorgensen and the move breaks down.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is teed up on the edge of the box by Nico Williams, and his howitzer of a shot into the top left corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Guillermo Cuadra.
